summary: The Starwave Echo event allows players to convert up to 50 unused Legendary Hero Imprints into Starwave Fragments at a rate of 12 fragments per imprint. Exchanging the maximum of 50 imprints yields 600 Starwave Fragments, which can be spent in the Temporal Corridor Lingering Echo shop. Exclusive support heroes cost 800 fragments, whereas exclusive DPS heroes cost 300 fragments. The creator recommends saving for exclusive supports since they are much harder to obtain, though players can also opt for two exclusive DPS heroes if they do not plan to use the available supports.

heroes.name: Rhash
heroes.note: Unused duplicate imprints can be recycled during the event into Starwave Fragments.
